g.text: Document Ref: SPEC-ADDC-2026-V1.0 | Classification: Systems Engineering
This document defines the high-level functional and safety requirements for the
next-generation Automated Driving Domain Controller (ADDC). The system interfaces
with long-range LiDAR, stereoscopic front cameras, and high-bandwidth radar clusters.
The domain controller shall process synchronized camera and radar frames within 40 ms of reception.
Under degraded optical visibility (< 20 m), the system shall trigger acoustic driver takeover alerts within 150 ms.
The microcontroller diagnostic watchdog shall achieve ASIL-D single-point fault metric >= 99.0%.

Target: Siemens Polarion ALM / Requirements Management / ReqIFZ
